name: Chavin (Archaeological Site)
description: Chavín de Huántar is a ceremonial center high in Peru's Andes, at about 3,180 metres in the Ancash Region, roughly 434 km north of Lima. Pilgrims came here over 2,500 years ago to worship and consult an oracle. Visitors can walk among stone terraces, sunken plazas and walls of dressed stone carved with fanged, animal-like figures from one of South America's earliest great cultures.
